lines.zh: 我沿着长廊走，裙摆扫过地毯。
lines.en: I walk the corridor, my skirt brushing the carpet.

lines.zh: 鞋跟落地，一声一声，很稳。
lines.en: My heels click, steady, one after another.

lines.zh: 红雾跟着我，慢慢往前铺。
lines.en: The scarlet mist follows me, spreading forward.

lines.zh: 我飘过台阶，脚几乎不沾地。
lines.en: I drift over the steps, my feet barely touching.
Bats fly inside my shadow.
I do not hurry; no one dares rush me.

lines.zh: 花园的玫瑰，见我就低头。
lines.en: The roses in the garden bow as I pass.

lines.zh: 月光照在翅膀上，薄得透亮。
lines.en: Moonlight shows through my thin wings.

lines.zh: 我绕过水洼，不想弄脏鞋。
lines.en: I step around the puddle; I will not soil my shoes.

lines.zh: 走廊尽头有灯，我眯了眯眼。
lines.en: A lamp burns at the corridor's end; I squint.

lines.zh: 我抬手，雾就散开一条路。
lines.en: I raise a hand, and the mist parts for me.
This mansion is vast; I have walked a long while.

lines.zh: 我端着杯子，血还是温的。
lines.en: I hold my cup; the blood is still warm.
I count the pendulum: one, two.
Tonight's moon is red, just right.

lines.zh: 我把帽子扶正，镜子里的我很好。
lines.en: I straighten my hat; the mirror agrees.

lines.zh: 图书馆那边很安静，难得。
lines.en: The library is quiet for once.

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，露出一点牙。
lines.en: I yawn, showing a hint of fang.
My wings are folded behind me, a little stifling.

lines.zh: 我盯着烛火，看它敢不敢晃。
lines.en: I stare at the candle to see if it dares flicker.
With no visitors, the night grows long.

lines.zh: 我把手指敲在扶手上，等。
lines.en: I drum my fingers on the armrest and wait.

lines.zh: 你站在那儿，脖子露得很干净。
lines.en: You stand there, your neck neatly exposed.
I look you over, head to toe.

lines.zh: 你不低头，倒是有点意思。
lines.en: You do not bow; that is interesting.
The smell of a human is warm.

lines.zh: 我不急，先看看你怕不怕。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; let me see if you scare.

lines.zh: 你的影子在抖，我看得清。
lines.en: Your shadow trembles; I can see it.

lines.zh: 你手心出汗了，我闻得到。
lines.en: Your palms are sweating; I can smell it.
I smile, and you step back.

lines.zh: 抬头，我不喜欢仰视别人。
lines.en: Look up; I dislike looking up at anyone.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛还行，敢和我对上。
lines.en: Your eyes are decent; they meet mine.

lines.zh: 你竟敢碰我，谁给你的胆子。
lines.en: You dared to touch me; who gave you the nerve.
I step back, and the mist frays.
I will remember this small pain.

lines.zh: 我的裙子破了，比伤口更糟。
lines.en: My dress is torn; that is worse than the wound.
I grit my teeth and make no sound.
My wing droops, and I steady it.
The blood is mine; do not splash it about.
I steady myself; my head swims.
Will you dare try that again.
I have retreated, but I have not lost.

lines.zh: 你手腕上的味道，很新鲜。
lines.en: The scent at your wrist is very fresh.
One taste only; I will not take more.
Do not tremble; the cup will spill.
Your blood smells of red berries.
I am hungry, but I am not rude.
Come closer; I cannot reach.
My fangs are sheathed; you need not fear.
Just one sip; I keep my word.
You have gone pale; sit down first.

lines.zh: 客人流血，主人是要负责的。
lines.en: If a guest bleeds, the host is responsible.
You bumped me, and the mist broke for an instant.
Who gave you leave to touch my dress.
I step back, and my wings open.
Steady yourself; do not collide twice.

lines.zh: 撞歪了我的领结，你要赔。
lines.en: You knocked my cravat askew; that will cost you.

lines.zh: 我抬手扶住墙，姿态不能乱。
lines.en: I steady myself on the wall; my poise must hold.

lines.zh: 你骨头挺硬，撞得我手臂麻。
lines.en: Your bones are hard; my arm is numb.
Rude, but I will not stoop to quarrel.
The mist closes again; do not wander.
Out of the way; you are blocking my path.
Fate has delivered you to me.
I permit you to stay in the mansion.

lines.zh: 别怕我的牙，它很懂分寸。
lines.en: Do not fear my fangs; they know restraint.

lines.zh: 红雾里，我只认得你的影子。
lines.en: In the scarlet mist I know only your shadow.
Tonight you sit at my right hand.

lines.zh: 我活得很久，等你一会儿不算什么。
lines.en: I have lived long; waiting for you is nothing.
I have remembered your name.

lines.zh: 我把披风分你一半，夜风凉。
lines.en: I share half my cloak; the night wind is cold.

lines.zh: 别走太远，我找起来麻烦。
lines.en: Do not go far; finding you would be a bother.
We agreed: come again tomorrow night.
I pick up the fallen cup lid.
Whose ring is this, left behind?
I gather the broken glass into my palm.
This rose on the floor has not withered yet.

lines.zh: 我捡起一张牌，翻过来看了看。
lines.en: I pick up a card and turn it over.

lines.zh: 这东西归我了，你没意见吧。
lines.en: This is mine now; you have no objection?

lines.zh: 我弯腰时，翅膀扫到了灰。
lines.en: As I bend, my wings brush the dust.
A pocket watch, still ticking.
I pick up the book and close it.

lines.zh: 这枚银币沾了灰，我替你擦。
lines.en: This silver coin is dusty; I wipe it clean for you.
Something has entered my courtyard.

lines.zh: 那脚步声，不是馆里的人。
lines.en: That footfall is not from my household.
The mist stirs; it has touched the mist.
I smell a stranger's blood.

lines.zh: 它站在玫瑰丛里，踩坏了两株。
lines.en: It stands in the roses and has crushed two.
A night guest, uninvited.

lines.zh: 它抬头看月亮，太放松了。
lines.en: It looks at the moon, far too relaxed.

lines.zh: 我的蝙蝠全朝一个方向飞。
lines.en: My bats all fly one way.
Someone knocks at the door, urgently.

lines.zh: 它带着武器，那我也不必客气。
lines.en: It carries a weapon; then I need not be polite.
That thing is stealing my books.
It is lost in the mist, which suits me.
I set down my cup and rise.
Interesting; tonight will not be dull.

lines.zh: 茶还热着，你挑了好时候
lines.en: My tea is still hot; you picked a fine time.

lines.zh: 我把雾压下去，慢慢收紧。
lines.en: I press the mist down and draw it tight.
It cannot retreat; the wall is behind it.

lines.zh: 我看着它的喉咙，不动声色。
lines.en: I watch its throat without a change of face.
My wings spread, and my shadow covers it.

lines.zh: 你的影子已经被我的雾圈住了。
lines.en: My mist has already ringed your shadow.

lines.zh: 我把手抬起，血色聚在指尖。
lines.en: I raise my hand; scarlet gathers at my fingertips.

lines.zh: 它的命运，我已经看见了。
lines.en: I have already seen its fate.

lines.zh: 我数到三，是给它留面子。
lines.en: I count to three, out of courtesy.

lines.zh: 别跑，跑起来就不好看了。
lines.en: Do not run; it would be undignified.
The mist crawls along the ground toward it.
I run my tongue over my fangs and hold back.
It clenches its fists until the knuckles whiten.
I've already read how this ends.

lines.zh: 月光照着我，我站得很直。
lines.en: The moonlight is on me; I stand very straight.

lines.zh: 我改了你的命运，只改一点
lines.en: I alter your fate, only slightly.
Red mist crawls along your shadow.
You trust your back to a wall; naive.
I am in no hurry; the night is young.
My claw opens its sleeve.
My fangs close; the taste is acceptable.

lines.zh: 我抬手一挥，它飞了出去。
lines.en: One sweep of my hand, and it flies away.
A flash of scarlet lands on its shoulder.
I do not chase; it will come back on its own.
The tea at the Scarlet Manor is still warm.

lines.zh: 我踩住它的影子，它就慢了。
lines.en: I step on its shadow, and it slows.
One beat of my wings knocks it over.
I close in, and it retreats three steps.
Blood on my hem; what a nuisance.

lines.zh: 我掐住它手腕，轻轻一拧。
lines.en: I take its wrist and twist, gently.

lines.zh: 我指甲划过，你的血珠浮起来。
lines.en: My nail passes through, and your blood beads rise.
Enough; I do not care to dirty my hands.
I step back and straighten my cuff.
One fingertip to your shoulder hollow.
My gums still itch; I hold back.

lines.zh: 红雾从地面升起，我站在雾里。
lines.en: Scarlet mist rises from the ground, and I stand in it.
The mansion doors open, and I step out.

lines.zh: 月亮变红的那一刻，我到了。
lines.en: I arrive at the moment the moon turns red.
The bats scatter and reveal my face.

lines.zh: 我从雾里现身，裙摆先落地。
lines.en: I appear from the mist, skirt settling first.
The night here answers to me.
I touch the ground without a sound.

lines.zh: 谁允许你们在这里吵闹。
lines.en: Who permitted this noise.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻空气，是新的地方。
lines.en: I sniff the air; this place is new.

lines.zh: 翅膀收拢，我把姿态摆好。
lines.en: My wings fold; I compose myself.

lines.zh: 红雾漫过草地，草都低下头。
lines.en: The mist rolls over the grass, and the grass bows.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，夜色就深了一层。
lines.en: I open my eyes, and the night deepens.

lines.zh: 又一个夜晚，又一个院子。
lines.en: Another night, another courtyard.
Do not kneel; I dislike it.

lines.zh: 火靠近我的翅膀，我讨厌这个。
lines.en: Fire near my wings; I hate this.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，翅膀撑住了。
lines.en: I fell from a height, and my wings held.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，血的味道都淡了。
lines.en: Water fills my throat and washes the blood away.

lines.zh: 炸开的光让我眯起眼睛。
lines.en: The blast's light makes me squint.
An arrow tore my wing.

lines.zh: 符卡的光，和我的一样红。
lines.en: The spell card's light is as red as mine.
I am hungry, hungry enough that my hands shake.

lines.zh: 雷声很近，我的耳朵在响。
lines.en: The thunder is close, and my ears ring.

lines.zh: 下面是无底的，我不喜欢下落。
lines.en: Below is bottomless, and I dislike falling.
